data.title: OpenAI counters Apple's trade secret lawsuit, seeks dismissal, and presents evidence against claims. Full story inside.
data.description: OpenAI responds to Apple's legal action claiming theft of trade secrets by filing a motion to dismiss the case. The company also releases evidence challenging Apple's allegations. This development comes after Apple accused OpenAI of stealing valuable proprietary information. The move to dismiss the case involves highlighting inconsistencies in Apple's claims and presenting counterarguments. OpenAI's response indicates a pushback against Apple's lawsuit and seeks to defend its reputation in the industry. The dispute between the two tech giants involves complex intellectual property issues and could have significant implications for both companies.
